prerequisites: General technical/engineering knowledge from the first year at an institute of technology

learning_outcomes.text: Describe different aspects of sustainability, what the effects are, what the development looks like right now, and how they are connected to different industries.
Describe and analyze companies' stakeholders, drivers, barriers, strategies, methods, innovation and policy development processes for managing sustainability aspects along the company's value chain.

Based on the above knowledge, account for and critically analyze the company's management of sustainability aspects related to organization, product portfolio, communication and stakeholder collaboration.
Based on the above knowledge, evaluate real cases of companies' handling of sustainability aspects, and propose well-motivated measures for the development of competitive sustainability work.
Show ability to communicate analysis about sustainable business within the company and with the company's external stakeholders in English and Swedish

syllabus_topics: Sustainability related to industry and global ecomomic development
Sustainability aspects, environmental and social issues
Sustainability policy, policy processes and legislation
Innovations, industrial dynamics and environmental economics
Product development and commercial sustainability work
assessment_rules: Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course. The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5.
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
